headline: Durk Takes 2 Major Ws in Court: Judge Won’t Refer to Victim as Lul Pab
body: Trap Lore Ross reports Durk secured two major legal setbacks in court. The post, shared on Instagram with 6,561 likes and 240 comments, highlights the courtroom drama’s cultural impact.
